line.end: That is all there is to it. Go on and ask for anything in the box below.
line.question: It's your turn. Open the row under “{{section}}”, choose an answer and send it.
line.result: A result is ready. Open the row under “{{section}}”, check it, and press “{{finish}}” if it is good.
line.send: Write what you want done in the box below and send it. It becomes a task listed here.
line.working: AI is working on it. When a question or a result comes for you, the task moves to “{{section}}”. Press a row to read its progress.

send.detail: Write it in the box below and send. Or pick an example.
send.title: Send a request

turn.detail: Open a task that has a question or a result for you, and answer or check it.
turn.title: Your turn

work.detail: Your request becomes a task listed here, and an agent works on it.
work.received: The coordinator (the AI that takes your requests) has your request. A task will appear here shortly. Press the line above the box to read the conversation.
work.title: AI works on it

pending.long: A new instruction arrived. Waiting for the owner to give a new report estimate.

timeView.axisAbsent: The time view is not saved on this device. It loads when the connection is back.
timeView.help: Scroll sideways to move through time. Zoom with ctrl (⌘) + wheel, a pinch, or two fingers. Double-click the time scale to see everything. Point at a line (tap on a phone) for details. Keys: + − 0 N; press → on a title to read its lines in turn.

decide.label: Pick a mini game idea, then have it built
decide.shows: AI offers ideas; pick one and it builds that game.
decide.words: I'd like one mini game I can play in the browser. Suggest 3 ideas and ask me which to build. Then build the one I pick in about 5 minutes. This is a trial run, so keep the effort light. Please write everything in English.

folder.label: Read this folder and suggest what to hand off next
folder.shows: Sums up what is in the working folder and asks you which piece of work to start with. Changes nothing.
folder.words: Make this a task and hand it to an agent. Read what is in this project's working folder ({{path}}) and sum up in three lines what the project is. Then suggest three pieces of work I could hand off next and ask me which to start with. Do not change any files. This is a trial run, so keep the effort light. Please write everything in English.

models.label: Have 3 models build a snake game, then compare
models.shows: Different models build in parallel, then you're asked which to keep.
models.words: Please build a snake game that runs in the browser, 3 times in parallel, each with a different model; if there aren't enough models, vary the effort instead. When they're done, ask me which one to keep. This is a trial run, so keep the settings light and take about 5 minutes. Please write everything in English.

settings.label: Set a working rule and how many agents run at once
settings.shows: A rule joins the project policy, and at most 4 agents run at once.
settings.words: Please add this rule to this project's policy: "When you finish, report what you changed in 3 lines or fewer." Also, set this environment to run at most 4 agents at once. Please write everything in English.

folder.none: To use it on your own repository, choose that folder as the project's working folder.

welcome.lead: Send what you want done. AI turns it into tasks and works on them, and comes to you only when your judgment is needed.
welcome.title: Welcome to alpacawork
